notes: Seed http://www.co.culberson.tx.us/ works over https; election pages are 'Elections 2026' and 'Elections 2019-2025'. No Clarity or vendor link. Election-night files are scanned Hart cumulative (county total) reports, read visually; Last-Modified values differ per file and follow PDF scan times. Culberson is treated as Central time (the brief names only Hudspeth and El Paso as Mountain). No precinct-level results are posted for these elections. 2026 primary undetermined (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: The 2024 general and 2026 runoff are both LATER (check 2: county totals only on election night), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. Confidence med because each has a printed run time and a server upload time on election night.
